personalInfo.name: Khushboo Singh
personalInfo.eyebrow: NLP · Machine Learning · Computational Social Science
personalInfo.title: Staff Researcher building human-centered language technologies.
personalInfo.summary: I develop NLP and machine learning systems that connect language with human behavior, psychological states, and real-world decision making — from multimodal PTSD research to on-device LLM evaluation.
personalInfo.about: I am a Staff Researcher at Vanderbilt University’s Human Language Analysis Beings (HLAB), where I work at the intersection of natural language processing, machine learning, and computational social science. My research focuses on language-based psychological and behavioral assessment, transformer and LLM representations, multimodal modeling, and scalable NLP tools. I earned my M.S. in Computer Science from Stony Brook University in 2025 and bring more than three years of software engineering experience to research systems that need to work beyond the lab.

professionalExperience.organization: Vanderbilt University · Human Language Analysis Beings (HLAB)
description: Contribute to the $4M, 24-month ARPA-H EVIDENT initiative developing multimodal models for PTSD treatment response, safety-risk assessment, and treatment matching.
Build NLP and deep-learning pipelines for linguistic and acoustic biomarkers, representation learning, feature APIs, and reproducible QA workflows.
Develop scalable human-centered NLP methods that connect language with psychological and behavioral assessment.
Analyzed 10K+ ecological momentary assessment texts to model longitudinal language patterns related to psychological states and traits.
Built speech-processing workflows over 10K+ samples using Whisper and Transformer models, with phonetic analysis using IPA, SAMPA, and Praat.
Studied language and speech signals associated with PTSD, depression (PHQ-9), and alcohol-use indicators.
Evaluated on-device LLM behavior for Ray-Ban Meta Glasses across multilingual voice-assistant experiences, including invocation failures, false captures, intent recognition, and domain routing.
Built F1-based evaluation and observability workflows across 9+ domains to identify regressions and prioritize high-impact language quality issues.
Created multilingual Natural Invocation data patches and collaborated cross-functionally on model quality improvements.

professionalExperience.organization: The Research Foundation for SUNY · World Trade Center Health Program
description: Developed Whisper and Transformer-based ASR/NLP pipelines for 10K+ speech samples from 9/11 responders.
Analyzed linguistic patterns associated with PTSD, depression, anxiety, and alcohol-use measures to support mental-health research.
Built production applications across e-commerce, education, fintech, search, ranking, and conversational AI using Python, Flutter, React, and cloud services.
Delivered and maintained multiple cross-platform products while mentoring junior developers and supporting release workflows.

academicProjects.title: Transformer Representations for Human States & Traits
academicProjects.summary: Systematic evaluation of language-model representations for psychological human-centered NLP across multiple temporal levels.
highlights: Benchmarked 13 Transformer/LLM families across 43 outcomes spanning affect, substance use, mental health, sociodemographics, and personality.
Achieved Pearson r ≈ 0.6 for mental-health outcomes and r > 0.7 for personality traits using stratified 10-fold Ridge Regression.

academicProjects.title: ARPA-H EVIDENT
academicProjects.summary: Federally funded research on data-driven PTSD care using multimodal behavioral and clinical signals.
highlights: Developing language and acoustic representations for treatment-response and safety-risk modeling.
Building reusable NLP feature extraction, validation, and QA pipelines for downstream modeling.

academicProjects.title: LegiMed AI
academicProjects.summary: Medical-document summarization designed for legally relevant review workflows.
highlights: Combined LLaMA 3, few-shot prompting, FAISS retrieval, and PubMedBERT embeddings.
Benchmarked T5, FLAN-T5, BART, BioBART, and GPT-based approaches for contextual accuracy and domain relevance.

academicProjects.title: Commodity Market Forecasting
academicProjects.summary: Explainable energy-market forecasting that combines numerical futures data with language from EIA reports.
highlights: Combined Time Series Transformers with LLaMA 2 and GPT-2 to forecast energy prices and generate explanations.
Explored cascading and joint multimodal architectures for interpretable forecasting.
